I’ve known Clinton personally  not just as a mechanic, but as a friend and a fellow rider. He and his brother are like family to me, and their passion for motorcycles truly reflects in the quality of work they do.

Clinton himself is a professional rider, has won several championships, and somehow still finds time to put his heart and soul into every bike that rolls into his garage. That passion truly shows in the work they do whether it’s a simple service, performance upgrade, or a full-blown modification project.

If you’re into sports bikes, dirt bikes, or even scooters, this is the place to go. You can walk in, talk to Clinton, share what you have in mind and he’ll make it happen. They even take up restoration projects, and the results are always top-notch.
